entries.computation: 仅解压既有gz JSON；统计action_history中action=measure且position=[0,0]的初始连续前缀；不加载模型或执行环境

entries.stopping_rule: Exactly fixed_runs cases regardless of source count, or error/STOP; retain all sampled cases.
